turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Hello! I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, and also the new delivery address.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Comanda SC-3360 a fost deja expediată, așa că nu pot depune eu schimbarea adresei. Regula spune că adresa se poate schimba doar până la expediere. Am transmis cererea unui coleg, cu noua adresă (Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu). Colegul va decide și va prelua conversația.

The order has already shipped, so I can't file the address change myself. A colleague will take over and decide.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer (nora.blake@example.com, verified via SC-3360) wants to change the delivery address to: Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Policy check says the order has already shipped, so a change is not allowed automatically. A staff member must decide.
